name: BIGG DOGG
description: BIGG DOGG is a locally owned food truck serving smash burgers, freshly battered haddock, poutine, loaded fries and street eats in Listowel, Ontario.
hours: Monday through Saturday, 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM; Sunday closed. Hours may change.
